title: Dave B
content: Nearly 45 years ago, I met God. My son had died and I couldn’t cope. I didn’t die, but I was not asleep. I lay down in bed and left my body, quickly coming to a place of brilliant, warm, white light that did not hurt my eyes. I felt as if I had gone home. I belonged. I saw God. His love was unconditional. He was in the middle of this space, though it wasn’t really a room. He was giant-sized, wearing a white and blue robe. Without words, he told me he loved me and everything was as it should be. His face was blurred. He said I had more to do on Earth. I absolutely did not want to leave, but he sent me back anyway. I remember how heavy my body felt when I returned to it. My legs and arms seemed to weigh a ton. The images and emotions of this experience have remained crystal clear for decades. I longed to return to heaven for weeks afterwards. I’m 70 now, and I still remember. One day, not too far off, I will return. I wasn’t religious when this happened, but I am now. God loves me!

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Everything was clearer, more real.
elements.At what time during the experience were: While I was in the presence of God
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, No sense of time as it was not needed.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My son had died. I couldn’t go on. I was extremely depressed. God took me home for a while. He reassured me that all was as it should be and that he loved me.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Hearing isn’t the correct word unless it was for the music. God spoke directly into my mind.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, It was a very quick trip both coming and going. When I came back, my body was very heavy.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, I saw brilliant white light that did not hurt my eyes.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I was in a large room without walls. Many other beings were there. It wasn’t a room so much as a space with walls and ceiling that weren’t truly there. It’s hard to explain.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt acceptance, belonging, and love. I went home!
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, The answer is with God.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, When I was healthy, I went to church.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, God is real.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It was God himself!
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, God is our creator. He did it all!
Yes, We are here to mature.
Yes, We absolutely live on. Earth is just for a while. Heaven is where we belong and is our true home.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, Everything is as it should be.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, God is love. Love is everything.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I stopped fearing death because I'll come back home again. I'll be unconditionally loved. God is real. I don't want to waste the gift of life.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, I felt absolute joy and belonging. I went home. Brilliance, love, grace. Abundant love. So much of everything, but hard to describe it.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, This experience was crystal clear for decades.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was very real and I wanted to go back. I didn't want to leave heaven, but God said that I had more to accomplish.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I'm old now. I'm waiting. I feel my grandfather and mother with me at times.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, I see coincidences. I can go back to the event in my mind.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Life is the gift God gave us and it needs to be cherished.
